description: Hybrid of exp134 (saturated) and exp135 (2NlogN lean): keep qk_joint saturated (tph=256, ~101% pair coverage per head) since attention patterns need full pair flexibility. Apply 2*N*log2(N) lean rule to v_lut (tph=96, 38%) and out_proj (tph=364, 16%). Same dims as exp134/135: E=64, d_qk=d_v=32, n_heads=6. Per-layer LUT: qk 25.17M + v 4.72M + out 5.96M = 35.85M. 6 layers: 215.1M LUT + ~15M = ~230M params.
